quote.subject_text: Further to your subject request please see below our offer for the SF6 Gas Test Equipment hiring charges
quote.notes: Note: we don't have any technical person for sf6 gas equipment operation. So sf6 gas equipment operation will be your responsibility. Because sf6 gas equipment operation is difficult for even a trained person. So all the responsibility for sf6 gas equipment operation will be yours only. As per our company policy once you take the equipment you have to pay equipment hiring charges on daily basis on rental period.
quote.terms_conditions:
1. Valid calibration certificate shall be provided by Servepower.
2. Mobilization and Demobilization is not in our scope.
3. The charges mentioned above is only for equipment rental and does not include training/engineering service.
4. Any damage of equipment's or missing accessories will be chargeable.
5. Payment terms: 100% equipment return time Cash/CDC.
6. Formal LPO / email confirmation specifying your requirement schedule only shall be considered for booking the equipment.
7. The availability of the equipment should be checked at least 1 week before your requirement schedule.
8. The above price do not include VAT. VAT charges shall be applicable over the total invoice value as per the UAE law (on 01-01-2018).
9. Above offer validity for 30 days.
quote.rate_basis_text:
Daily rate: For continuous rental period of less than 6 days
Weekly rate: For continuous rental period of 7 days or less than 25 days
Monthly rate: For continuous rental period of 26 days or more
